selection_rule: highest train OOF caution F1 subject to specificity >= 0.85; ties prefer simpler strategy

short_text_floor.selection_rule: minimize observed malicious moderate-ML floor removals; within that set maximize legitimate floor removals; ties choose the smallest tested N.
short_text_floor.provenance: Chosen from train OOF rows only using alphanumeric_token_count(text) from train.jsonl; no validation rows used.

learned_meta.reason: No new trained production artifact is permitted in Phase 4; a runtime-loaded meta model would violate the frozen-artifact boundary.
